lesson: Failure codes and retry safety. EFFECT_INDETERMINATE means the tool threw and the effect may or may not have occurred: do not claim it failed safely and do not automatically retry it. OUTPUT_REJECTED is different and stronger: the tool completed, so for a write, network or process tool the effect DID occur and only its output was unusable, so never describe it as not having happened and never retry it. INPUT_INVALID means the resolved input failed validation before the tool ran, so no effect occurred. TOOL_FAILED applies to a pure tool only. Every failure carries a reason naming which rule broke.
